session: referenced_digests now the package collector over the document + held import entries, so assets_available, render_assets (viewer mask planes incl. smart-filter masks) and retain_replaced_assets cover every plane

(4) harness tests/viewer_mask_package.rs: PSD with a user mask + raster records (mask parameters, smart-filter stack with stack mask and per-filter mask) imported, saved through the session streaming save (Viewer::save), reopened: all 3 mask planes byte-identical in the saved package, viewer frame byte-identical to a direct composite lower_to_render_plan_extended + render-cpu render with 3 masks served, and differs from the same frame with inverted mask planes
